text: Mihai - knee op @ St Thomas's Thurs at 8am. text him the night before, then ring the next day once he's home
Jada starts @ Deloitte Mon. v nervous re: 1st day, her old boss poached half the team apparently

Ming's cat Biscuit - kidney thing, vet again Fri at 4. she's not sleeping. Biscuit's 16 and the vet mentioned options if bloods come back worse, so she's bracing herself. her daughter Grace home from uni this wknd which helps. Ming's also got her own appt at the fracture clinic Mon morning re: wrist. text her Fri evening after the vet
new puppy for Rafael & Leah!! cockapoo called Pickle. collecting him Sat morning
Graham retiring end of Nov after 31 yrs @ the council. leaving do the 28th at half 6, Red Lion. chip in for card + gift the week before
Elijah - hernia op cancelled again, hospital ran out of beds. rebooked for 14th, not holding breath
Sadia: promoted to head of ops. her husband Obi said she's been working towards it for ages. send congrats
Suzanne's mum in hospital since Sunday, fall + broken hip. Suzanne back & forth every day, knackered. drop round some food tomorrow evening?
dentist Tues 10.15. car MOT same day afternoon - drop off before

Rhys - dog Monty turns 10 next wk. he's doing a doggy cake lol. Monty's been slowing down, arthritis in back legs, vet thinks he's got a couple of good years. Rhys's partner Oliver wants a second dog, Rhys says absolutely not yet. Monty party Sun afternoon in the park, I'm invited. bring a tennis ball
Malik had his gallbladder out last Weds. check how recovery going
Grace interview @ Great Ormond St tmrw at 11. wish her luck that morning. she said she nearly pulled out
Noah - last day @ Tesco Fri, then off to uni in Leeds. leaving drinks afterwards @ Wetherspoons
Seo-yeon: scan results back Thurs afternoon. she's v anxious. call her that evening
Julia & Pedro - both made redundant same week. Julia says fine, Pedro clearly not. meet him for a pint
Esme's rabbit Clover died over the wknd. 6 yrs old. her kids devastated
Ebony - new job @ BBC from 3 Nov, producer role. asked if I knew anyone in Salford. ask Ayo, he's up there
Ayo knows loads of ppl @ MediaCity. vegan, hates coriander. birthday sometime Dec I think
Zofia - cataract op the 9th at half 9. her son Thabo driving her, I'm picking her up afterwards. text the day before to check timings

Mai's dad - heart bypass done Tues, ICU 2 days, now on ward. she's flying back from Osaka Sun, lands 7am Heathrow. her brother Malik has been at the hospital the whole time, sleeping in the car some nights. Mai feels awful she wasn't there. dad's 74, diabetic. message her when she lands, and offer to drive her down to Southampton the day after

Mohammed got the promotion!! senior engineer, finally, after being passed over twice. new role starts 1 Dec, he'll be managing 6 ppl incl. his old mentor Graham which is awkward. celebrating Sat at 7 at theirs, his wife Elif organising, kids at her mum's. Elif said he'd love a nice notebook for the new job. bring something + a bottle

Aiko - 1st week @ the new practice went ok, boss bit intense. she's the only vet on Saturdays which wasn't in the job ad. commute is 50 mins each way now, thinking about moving closer in the new year, maybe Didsbury. her partner Obi works from home so he doesn't mind. probation review 6 wks in, so mid Dec. ask again in a fortnight how she's settling

Shanice's kitten Mochi - spayed tomorrow morning. drop off 8, collect at 4. she's more nervous than the cat tbh. also mentioned her landlord might not renew in Feb so she's looking at flats w/ her cousin, which means maybe a move in spring. she's been offered extra shifts too but turning them down for now. text her tomorrow afternoon to see how Mochi did

Jamal: physio after ACL surgery, 3x/wk. can't drive till Jan. offered lifts Weds mornings. he's gutted about missing the season - Sunday league captain, they're top of the table. his girlfriend Ebony says he's been really low, not leaving the flat much. maybe get the lads round for the match Sat at 3
Oliver Baker aka Olly - moving to Bristol office in spring, team lead. his partner Rhys not thrilled about the move

Aarav - leaving the bank after 12 yrs, going freelance. last day 31st. said he's terrified but excited. his wife Ming fully behind it, she's back at work full time from Jan to cover the mortgage. first client already lined up, pitch on 4 Nov at 10am. team doing a farewell lunch on his last day. take him for lunch the week after & ask how the pitch went
collect prescription Fri before 6. buy dog food. vet for Rolo booked Mon at 9.20
Leah's brother Noah - colonoscopy Thurs. she's taking him. ask her afterwards how it went
Grace said Graham's wife Julia is coeliac. gluten free for the leaving do!!
Elif - induction day at the hospital Mon at 9, new ward sister role. starts nights the week after. text good luck Sun night
Ming update: Biscuit home, on meds twice a day. Ming relieved but broke - vet bill £900
Dr Santos said results by Weds. my follow up appt 2 wks after that, morning slot
Rafael - op on his shoulder Fri, keyhole. Leah off work to look after him. they have to cancel the Lisbon trip
Pedro's interview @ the airport Tues at 2pm. 2nd round. ring him that evening
Sadia mentioned Obi's 40th in Jan. hinting about a decent coffee machine. she said he'd never buy one himself
Thabo - fostering a greyhound, Luna, rescue from Romford. nervous around men apparently
Uncle Graham in for his hip replacement 4 Dec. Aunt Suzanne staying w/ Esme for the week. must visit once he's home, maybe the weekend after
Jada update - first wk survived. new manager Ms Tanaka seems lovely. ask her about the training course in Nov
Mihai's surgery moved - now Fri at 7am not Thurs. still text the night before
Shanice: started @ the vets!! receptionist for now, wants to train as a nurse. loves it
Ebony nervous abt telling her boss she's leaving. doing it tomorrow at 10. text her at lunch
Malik's mum - chemo starting the 15th, every 3 wks. he's going part time to take her. don't forget to check in w/ him after the first session
Zofia - Polish, lives above the bakery on Mill Rd. 2 grandkids, collects teapots
Rhys Olsen - big presentation to the board Weds at 3. said he's not slept. send good luck msg that morning
Aiko's dog Kuma - hit by a bike, leg in a cast. back to the vet in 10 days
Julia - starts @ the school Mon as TA. her daughter Esme in the same school lol. ask how the first day was
Oliver: hates surprise parties. allergic to nuts. into bouldering
Noah mentioned Elijah's back in hospital - infection after the op. his partner Mai staying over most nights. need to message Elijah tonight, keep it light
gym 7am tmrw, then work. pick up Mum's birthday card at lunch
Mohammed & Elif - 10 yr anniversary on the 22nd. going to Paris that wknd. Elif wants a new camera strap?? tell Mohammed
Grace got the job!! starts in Jan. call her Fri at 6ish to celebrate properly
Jamal - MRI tomorrow at 4. results next week. bring him the book I promised
Suzanne Moreau - just made partner at the firm. 15 yrs there. her husband Pedro throwing a do on the 2nd, 8pm, I'm doing the cake
Seo-yeon's cat Nabi turns 1 on Sunday. she's genuinely throwing a party for it. maybe a cat toy as a joke gift
Ayo - knee scan Weds morning, ortho appt the week after. thinks it's cartilage. struggling w/ stairs. ring him Weds afternoon
Mai - hen do 14-16 Nov in Dublin, wedding March. her sister Aiko is MOH
Leah said Rafael's op went fine, home already, bored stiff. she's back at work Mon. pop round Sat with snacks for him
Elijah update: discharged this morning. off work 6 wks min. his boss has been decent apparently

Long call w/ Thabo. his dad Obi had a stroke Sunday night, in the stroke unit at the General. speech affected but improving each day. Thabo's taken compassionate leave from the new job - only started there 3 wks ago, worried about it. his sister flying in from Jo'burg Thurs. offered to do airport run Thurs at 6am. check in with him Fri, and again the day after the consultant meeting next Tues

Esme Nakamura - new head of science role from Jan. currently deputy at the girls' school. stressed about the interview panel Mon 9am, 3 internal candidates. she asked me to read her presentation tomorrow evening. send good luck text Sun night and ask how it went that afternoon. her husband Rhys is taking the kids to her mum's so she can prep
